_about: Release 0.2.7 (4 Nov 2026), GitHub issue 7: the missile button held fires the torpedo in every preset and while the autopilot flies, and a cruise disruptor when the ship has one and no torpedo. docs\UI_SPEC.json has carried the bindings since 88e761b8; this patch brings them to the mock-up source and to ui/spec. No row or help text changes: core\ui_meta.h stays as shipped.

notes: Built 4 Nov 2026 (0.2.7): the wheel's CRUISE DISRUPTOR stays, and the missile button held (RB in FREELANCER, ASSISTED and under the autopilot, B in ACE) also fires a cruise disruptor when the ship has one and no torpedo; HUD 2's torpedo row then says HOLD for it. Tested on a virtual pad, not a real one.
